summary: Game Arts' adventure-focused JRPG series, covering the Saturn and PlayStation original, Dreamcast sequel, handheld and PS2 spinoffs, Grandia III, the Japan-only MMO, and the modern HD Collection.

entries.title: Grandia

primary.how_to_play: Play Grandia HD Remaster on Windows/Steam at the display resolution that best fits capture; use the Switch or PS4/Xbox HD Collection only if console capture is preferred.

entries.title: Grandia Online

emulation.notes: Client/server availability is the limiting factor.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Windows client output while the service existed.

primary.why: Grandia Online was the series' Japanese Windows MMORPG and was officially shut down on September 28, 2012.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical service-game entry unless a legal preserved server/client route exists; do not plan a normal playthrough.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented official platform; service shutdown controls playability.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The official service has ended, so completeness depends on historical preservation rather than platform choice.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service shut down September 28, 2012; no official offline version documented.
